description: As if dying from overwork wasn't unfair enough, why must I be a minor villainess in an R-19 dark romance novel? Harin, a successful beauty influencer, wakes up as 'Lynne Cert,' a minor villainess in the novel . Her goal for this life is clear: absolute wealth, fame, and keeping her distance from the tortured protagonists! But the more she tries to avoid him, the closer she gets to the male lead, 'Miller von Periharts'... Why does this man keep showing such intense interest in my body? \*\*Original Webtoon:\*\* \[Naver Webtoon\](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=856110), \[Naver Series\](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=14821965)
